# dbs-standard-answer: theory mining and historical-pattern standard answers

Curated by Skill Harbor — a short pointer to @dontbesilent2025's theory-and-history research skill: for one complex question it runs two linked parts — (1) knowledge and theory mining (proposition review, cross-discipline mapping, theory screening with a scoring rubric, identity/source verification, mapping theory onto the user's problem), then (2) historical isomorphism (compress the problem into a "structural fingerprint", study success/failure/counterexample cases with an analogy matrix, judge the standard answer's maturity level: mature consensus, conditional answer, or no unified answer yet) — with strict source standards and calibrated evidence strength.
